title: Little Erhei Gets Married
synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.

fullText.simplified:
三花会同意吗

    多喜被抓，三花不但不着急，还很高兴。她觉得自己管不了多喜，不能让多喜和张先生结婚，可以让区里的人管管。所以，听到多喜被抓，她也不担心，很早就上床睡觉了。
    第二天早上，她起来得很晚。多喜的爸爸水生虽然很着急，但又不敢去叫她起床，只好自己先去做饭。等了很久，三花才起床。
    水生问她：“你不去打听打听多喜吗？也不知道她怎么样了。”
    三花笑了：“打听她干什么？她不是不想跟张先生结婚吗？让她去。你也不能去找她！”
    水生不敢说话了。他把饭做好，放在桌子上等三花，直到她打扮好以后才开始吃饭。
    他们饭还没有吃完，大黑来了。他告诉三花说区里的人要她去区里问话。三花听后很高兴，大声说道：“女儿大了，管不了了。正好，可以让区长帮我们管管她。”
    三花吃完饭，换上了漂亮的新衣服，新鞋子，打扮了很久，才让水生准备马车，带她去区里。
    到了区里，三花一见到区长，就拉着他说：“区长啊，请区长帮帮忙啊！！”
    区长正在看报纸。他拿开报纸一看，看到一个穿着大花衣服，大绿鞋子的老女人。他不敢相信自己的眼睛，问道：“你……你是多喜的妈妈？”
    三花点点头说是。
    区长把她拉开，说：“站到那边去！”
    三花走到了桌子的那边。
    区长把三花从头到脚看了又看，问道：“你几岁了？”
    “四十五。”三花回答。
    “你自己看看，你打扮得像不像个人？”
    三花看了看自己的衣服，没有说话。
    区长又问：“听说有天神住在你的身体里？”
    三花不敢回答。
    “听说，你给你女儿找了个丈夫？”
    “是的。”三花小声地说。
    “收了他多少钱？”
    “一万。”三花的声音越来越小。
    “你有没有和你的女儿商量过？”
    “没有。”
    “你的女儿愿不愿意？”
    “不知道！”三花的声音几乎听不见了。
    “不知道？我帮你叫你的女儿过来，你自己问问她。”区长说完，让人去把多喜找来。
    这时，区长办公室外面来了很多人，大家不知道从哪儿听说了这里有个打扮得花花绿绿的老女人，大家都想来看看。大家一起在办公室门外，说说笑笑。这个说：“看看！四十五了！还穿着花衣服。”那个说：“看看，看看！那个鞋子！是四十五岁的人穿的吗？”……
    三花长这么大没有脸红过，这会儿却脸红了，觉得很不好意思。
    多喜被带进了区长办公室。区长看向三花：“你问问你女儿愿不愿意。”
    三花没有听到区长的话，只听见门外的人说“四十五”，“穿花衣服”，她觉得很不好意思。门外的人们还在说着，“你看，那是她的女儿”，“女儿没有她妈妈会打扮呢”，也有人说“听说有天神住在她的身体里”，又有个知道点事情的人说“那不是真的。她是为了和小伙子玩儿才这么说的”……听到这些话，三花真希望能马上跑出这个办公室，马上跑回家。
    区长见三花不说话，就说：“你不问我帮你问吧！多喜，你妈妈给你找的那个丈夫，你愿意跟他结婚吗？”
    多喜说：“不愿意！我连他的面都没有见过，他是谁我都不知道！”
    区长看向三花：“你听见了吧？多喜不愿意。我问过了，多喜想和你们村的高二黑结婚。现在和以前不一样了，现在不是爸爸妈妈决定孩子和谁结婚了。孩子们可以自己决定和谁约会，和谁结婚。多喜和高二黑可以结婚。你快把那位先生的见面礼全部都还回去吧，让多喜跟高二黑结婚吧……”
    三花现在只想快点回家，所以区长说什么她都点头，全部都答应下来了。
fullText.traditional:
三花會同意嗎

    多喜被抓，三花不但不著急，還很高興。她覺得自己管不了多喜，不能讓多喜和張先生結婚，可以讓區裡的人管管。所以，聽到多喜被抓，她也不擔心，很早就上床睡覺了。
    第二天早上，她起來得很晚。多喜的爸爸水生雖然很著急，但又不敢去叫她起床，只好自己先去做飯。等了很久，三花才起床。
    水生問她：“你不去打聽打聽多喜嗎？也不知道她怎麼樣了。”
    三花笑了：“打聽她幹什麼？她不是不想跟張先生結婚嗎？讓她去。你也不能去找她！”
    水生不敢說話了。他把飯做好，放在桌子上等三花，直到她打扮好以後才開始吃飯。
    他們飯還沒有吃完，大黑來了。他告訴三花說區裡的人要她去區裡問話。三花聽後很高興，大聲說道：“女兒大了，管不了了。正好，可以讓區長幫我們管管她。”
    三花吃完飯，換上了漂亮的新衣服，新鞋子，打扮了很久，才讓水生準備馬車，帶她去區裡。
    到了區裡，三花一見到區長，就拉著他說：“區長啊，請區長幫幫忙啊！！”
    區長正在看報紙。他拿開報紙一看，看到一個穿著大花衣服，大綠鞋子的老女人。他不敢相信自己的眼睛，問道：“你……你是多喜的媽媽？”
    三花點點頭說是。
    區長把她拉開，說：“站到那邊去！”
    三花走到了桌子的那邊。
    區長把三花從頭到腳看了又看，問道：“你幾歲了？”
    “四十五。”三花回答。
    “你自己看看，你打扮得像不像個人？”
    三花看了看自己的衣服，沒有說話。
    區長又問：“聽說有天神住在你的身體裡？”
    三花不敢回答。
    “聽說，你給你女兒找了個丈夫？”
    “是的。”三花小聲地說。
    “收了他多少錢？”
    “一萬。”三花的聲音越來越小。
    “你有沒有和你的女兒商量過？”
    “沒有。”
    “你的女兒願不願意？”
    “不知道！”三花的聲音幾乎聽不見了。
    “不知道？我幫你叫你的女兒過來，你自己問問她。”區長說完，讓人去把多喜找來。
    這時，區長辦公室外面來了很多人，大家不知道從哪兒聽說了這裡有個打扮得花花綠綠的老女人，大家都想來看看。大家一起在辦公室門外，說說笑笑。這個說：“看看！四十五了！還穿著花衣服。”那個說：“看看，看看！那個鞋子！是四十五歲的人穿的嗎？”……
    三花長這麼大沒有臉紅過，這會兒卻臉紅了，覺得很不好意思。
    多喜被帶進了區長辦公室。區長看向三花：“你問問你女兒願不願意。”
    三花沒有聽到區長的話，只聽見門外的人說“四十五”，“穿花衣服”，她覺得很不好意思。門外的人們還在說著，“你看，那是她的女兒”，“女兒沒有她媽媽會打扮呢”，也有人說“聽說有天神住在她的身體裡”，又有個知道點事情的人說“那不是真的。她是為了和小伙子玩兒才這麼說的”……聽到這些話，三花真希望能馬上跑出這個辦公室，馬上跑回家。
    區長見三花不說話，就說：“你不問我幫你問吧！多喜，你媽媽給你找的那個丈夫，你願意跟他結婚嗎？”
    多喜說：“不願意！我連他的面都沒有見過，他是誰我都不知道！”
    區長看向三花：“你聽見了吧？多喜不願意。我問過了，多喜想和你們村的高二黑結婚。現在和以前不一樣了，現在不是爸爸媽媽決定孩子和誰結婚了。孩子們可以自己決定和誰約會，和誰結婚。多喜和高二黑可以結婚。你快把那位先生的見面禮全部都還回去吧，讓多喜跟高二黑結婚吧……”
    三花現在只想快點回家，所以區長說什麼她都點頭，全部都答應下來了。

sentences.traditional: 三花看了看自己的衣服，沒有說話。
sentences.pinyin: sān huā kàn le kàn zì jǐ de yī fu méi yǒu shuō huà
sentences.english: Sanhua glanced at her clothes, and didn’t say anything.

sentences.simplified: 区长又问：“听说有天神住在你的身体里？”
sentences.traditional: 區長又問：“聽說有天神住在你的身體裡？”
sentences.pinyin: qū zhǎng yòu wèn tīng shuō yǒu tiān shén zhù zài nǐ de shēn tǐ lǐ
sentences.english: The district chief then asked, “I’ve heard that a god lives inside of your body?”

sentences.simplified: 三花不敢回答。
sentences.traditional: 三花不敢回答。
sentences.pinyin: sān huā bù gǎn huí dá
sentences.english: Sanhua didn’t dare reply.

sentences.simplified: “听说，你给你女儿找了个丈夫？”
sentences.traditional: “聽說，你給你女兒找了個丈夫？”
sentences.pinyin: tīng shuō nǐ gěi nǐ nǚ ér zhǎo le ge zhàng fu
sentences.english: “I’ve heard that you have found a husband for your daughter?”

sentences.simplified: “是的。”三花小声地说。
sentences.traditional: “是的。”三花小聲地說。
sentences.pinyin: shì de sān huā xiǎo shēng de shuō
sentences.english: “That’s right,” Sanhua said quietly.

sentences.simplified: “收了他多少钱？”
sentences.traditional: “收了他多少錢？”
sentences.pinyin: shōu le tā duō shao qián
sentences.english: “How much money did you receive?”

sentences.simplified: “一万。”三花的声音越来越小。
sentences.traditional: “一萬。”三花的聲音越來越小。
sentences.pinyin: yí wàn sān huā de shēng yīn yuè lái yuè xiǎo
sentences.english: “Ten thousand,” Sanhua’s voice was getting quieter.

sentences.simplified: “你有没有和你的女儿商量过？”
sentences.traditional: “你有沒有和你的女兒商量過？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu hé nǐ de nǚ ér shāng liang guò
sentences.english: “Have you discussed this with your daughter?”

sentences.simplified: “没有。”
sentences.traditional: “沒有。”
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu
sentences.english: “No.”

sentences.simplified: “你的女儿愿不愿意？”
sentences.traditional: “你的女兒願不願意？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ de nǚ ér yuàn bú yuàn yì
sentences.english: “Is your daughter willing?”

sentences.simplified: “不知道！”三花的声音几乎听不见了。
sentences.traditional: “不知道！”三花的聲音幾乎聽不見了。
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào sān huā de shēng yīn jī hū tīng bu jiàn le
sentences.english: “I don’t know!” Sanhua’s voice was barely audible.

sentences.simplified: “不知道？我帮你叫你的女儿过来，你自己问问她。”
sentences.traditional: “不知道？我幫你叫你的女兒過來，你自己問問她。”
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào wǒ bāng nǐ jiào nǐ de nǚ ér guò lái nǐ zì jǐ wèn wen tā
sentences.english: “You don’t know? I’ll bring your daughter here for you, and you can ask her yourself.”

sentences.simplified: 区长说完，让人去把多喜找来。
sentences.traditional: 區長說完，讓人去把多喜找來。
sentences.pinyin: qū zhǎng shuō wán ràng rén qù bǎ duō xǐ zhǎo lái
sentences.english: After the district chief finished speaking, he got someone to bring Duoxi over.

sentences.simplified: 这时，区长办公室外面来了很多人，
sentences.traditional: 這時，區長辦公室外面來了很多人，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí qū zhǎng bàn gōng shì wài miàn lái le hěn duō rén
sentences.english: At this time, many people arrived outside the district chief’s office.

sentences.simplified: 大家不知道从哪儿听说了这里有个打扮得花花绿绿的老女人，大家都想来看看。
sentences.traditional: 大家不知道從哪兒聽說了這裡有個打扮得花花綠綠的老女人，大家都想來看看。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā bù zhī dào cóng nǎ'r tīng shuō le zhè lǐ yǒu ge dǎ ban de huā huā lǜ lǜ de lǎo nǚ rén dà jiā dōu xiǎng lái kàn kan
sentences.english: They had all heard from somewhere that there was a gaudily-dressed old woman there, and they wanted to come and look.

sentences.simplified: 大家一起在办公室门外，说说笑笑。
sentences.traditional: 大家一起在辦公室門外，說說笑笑。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā yì qǐ zài bàn gōng shì mén wài shuō shuō xiào xiào
sentences.english: They were all standing outside of the office door, talking and laughing.

sentences.simplified: 这个说：“看看！四十五了！还穿着花衣服。”
sentences.traditional: 這個說：“看看！四十五了！還穿著花衣服。”
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shuō kàn kan sì shí wǔ le hái chuān zhe huā yī fu
sentences.english: One person said, “Look! She’s already forty-five and still wearing flowery clothing.”

sentences.simplified: 那个说：“看看，看看！那个鞋子！是四十五岁的人穿的吗？”……
sentences.traditional: 那個說：“看看，看看！那個鞋子！是四十五歲的人穿的嗎？”……
sentences.pinyin: nà ge shuō kàn kan kàn kan nà ge xié zi shì sì shí wǔ suì de rén chuān de ma
sentences.english: Another said, “Look, look! Those shoes! Is that a forty-five-year-old wearing them?” …

sentences.simplified: 三花长这么大没有脸红过，这会儿却脸红了，觉得很不好意思。
sentences.traditional: 三花長這麼大沒有臉紅過，這會兒卻臉紅了，覺得很不好意思。
sentences.pinyin: sān huā zhǎng zhè me dài méi yǒu liǎn hóng guò zhè huì'r què liǎn hóng le jué de hěn bù hǎo yì si
sentences.english: Sanhua hadn’t ever gotten red in the face in her life. Now she was red in the face and felt very embarrassed.

sentences.simplified: 多喜被带进了区长办公室。
sentences.traditional: 多喜被帶進了區長辦公室。
sentences.pinyin: duō xǐ bèi dài jìn le qū zhǎng bàn gōng shì
sentences.english: Duoxi was brought into the district chief’s office.

sentences.simplified: 区长看向三花：“你问问你女儿愿不愿意。”
sentences.traditional: 區長看向三花：“你問問你女兒願不願意。”
sentences.pinyin: qū zhǎng kàn xiàng sān huā nǐ wèn wen nǐ nǚ ér yuàn bú yuàn yì
sentences.english: The district chief looked towards Sanhua, “Ask your daughter if she is willing.”

sentences.simplified: 三花没有听到区长的话，
sentences.traditional: 三花沒有聽到區長的話，
sentences.pinyin: sān huā méi yǒu tīng dào qū zhǎng de huà
sentences.english: Sanhua didn’t hear what the district chief said.

sentences.simplified: 只听见门外的人说“四十五”，“穿花衣服”，她觉得很不好意思。
sentences.traditional: 只聽見門外的人說“四十五”，“穿花衣服”，她覺得很不好意思。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ tīng jiàn mén wài de rén shuō sì shí wǔ chuān huā yī fu tā jué de hěn bù hǎo yì si
sentences.english: She only heard people outside saying “forty-five”, “wearing flowery clothes”, and felt very embarrassed.

sentences.simplified: 门外的人们还在说着，“你看，那是她的女儿”，“女儿没有她妈妈会打扮呢”，
sentences.traditional: 門外的人們還在說著，“你看，那是她的女兒”，“女兒沒有她媽媽會打扮呢”，
sentences.pinyin: mén wài de rén men hái zài shuō zhe nǐ kàn nà shì tā de nǚ ér nǚ ér méi yǒu tā mā ma huì dǎ ban ne
sentences.english: The people outside were also saying, “Look, that’s her daughter”, “The daughter doesn’t dress as well as her mother”.

sentences.simplified: 也有人说“听说有天神住在她的身体里”，
sentences.traditional: 也有人說“聽說有天神住在她的身體裡”，
sentences.pinyin: yě yǒu rén shuō tīng shuō yǒu tiān shén zhù zài tā de shēn tǐ lǐ
sentences.english: Other people were saying, “I’ve heard that a god lives in her body”.

sentences.simplified: 又有个知道点事情的人说“那不是真的。她是为了和小伙子玩儿才这么说的”……
sentences.traditional: 又有個知道點事情的人說“那不是真的。她是為了和小伙子玩兒才這麼說的”……
sentences.pinyin: yòu yǒu ge zhī dào diǎn shì qing de rén shuō nà bú shì zhēn de tā shì wèi le hé xiǎo huǒ zi wán'r cái zhè me shuō de
sentences.english: Someone who knew a little said, “That’s not true. She only says that so she can hang out with young guys” …

sentences.simplified: 听到这些话，三花真希望能马上跑出这个办公室，马上跑回家。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這些話，三花真希望能馬上跑出這個辦公室，馬上跑回家。
sentences.pinyin: tīng dào zhè xiē huà sān huā zhēn xī wàng néng mǎ shàng pǎo chū zhè ge bàn gōng shì mǎ shàng pǎo huí jiā
sentences.english: After hearing all of this, Sanhua really wanted to run out of the office immediately and go home right away.

sentences.simplified: 区长见三花不说话，就说：“你不问我帮你问吧！
sentences.traditional: 區長見三花不說話，就說：“你不問我幫你問吧！
sentences.pinyin: qū zhǎng jiàn sān huā bù shuō huà jiù shuō nǐ bú wèn wǒ bāng nǐ wèn ba
sentences.english: The district chief saw that Sanhua wasn’t speaking, and said, ”If you aren’t going to ask, I’ll ask for you!

sentences.simplified: 多喜，你妈妈给你找的那个丈夫，你愿意跟他结婚吗？”
sentences.traditional: 多喜，你媽媽給你找的那個丈夫，你願意跟他結婚嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: duō xǐ nǐ mā ma gěi nǐ zhǎo de nà ge zhàng fu nǐ yuàn yì gēn tā jié hūn ma
sentences.english: Duoxi, your mother has found a husband for you. Are you willing to marry him?”

sentences.simplified: 多喜说：“不愿意！我连他的面都没有见过，他是谁我都不知道！”
sentences.traditional: 多喜說：“不願意！我連他的面都沒有見過，他是誰我都不知道！”
sentences.pinyin: duō xǐ shuō bú yuàn yì wǒ lián tā de miàn dōu méi yǒu jiàn guò tā shì shéi wǒ dōu bù zhī dào
sentences.english: Duoxi said, “No! I haven’t even seen his face; I don’t even know who he is!”

sentences.simplified: 区长看向三花：“你听见了吧？多喜不愿意。
sentences.traditional: 區長看向三花：“你聽見了吧？多喜不願意。
sentences.pinyin: qū zhǎng kàn xiàng sān huā nǐ tīng jiàn le ba duō xǐ bú yuàn yì
sentences.english: The district chief looked towards Sanhua, “Did you hear that? Duoxi is not willing.

sentences.simplified: 我问过了，多喜想和你们村的高二黑结婚。
sentences.traditional: 我問過了，多喜想和你們村的高二黑結婚。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ wèn guò le duō xǐ xiǎng hé nǐ men cūn de gāo èr hēi jié hūn
sentences.english: I already asked. Duoxi wants to marry Gao Erhei from your village.

sentences.simplified: 现在和以前不一样了，
sentences.traditional: 現在和以前不一樣了，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài hé yǐ qián bù yí yàng le
sentences.english: Things are different now than they were in the past.

sentences.simplified: 现在不是爸爸妈妈决定孩子和谁结婚了。
sentences.traditional: 現在不是爸爸媽媽決定孩子和誰結婚了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài bú shì bà ba mā ma jué dìng hái zi hé shéi jié hūn le
sentences.english: Now it’s no longer up to the parents to decide to whom their children get married.

sentences.simplified: 孩子们可以自己决定和谁约会，和谁结婚。多喜和高二黑可以结婚。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們可以自己決定和誰約會，和誰結婚。多喜和高二黑可以結婚。
sentences.pinyin: hái zi men kě yǐ zì jǐ jué dìng hé shéi yuē huì hé shéi jié hūn duō xǐ hé gāo èr hēi kě yǐ jié hūn
sentences.english: Children can decide whom they date and whom they marry. Duoxi and Erhei can get married.

sentences.simplified: 你快把那位先生的见面礼全部都还回去吧，让多喜跟高二黑结婚吧……”
sentences.traditional: 你快把那位先生的見面禮全部都還回去吧，讓多喜跟高二黑結婚吧……”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ kuài bǎ nà wèi xiān sheng de jiàn miàn lǐ quán bù dōu huán huí qù ba ràng duō xǐ gēn gāo èr hēi jié hūn ba
sentences.english: Hurry and return all the greeting gifts from that man, and let Duoxi and Erhei get married …”

sentences.simplified: 三花现在只想快点回家，
sentences.traditional: 三花現在只想快點回家，
sentences.pinyin: sān huā xiàn zài zhǐ xiǎng kuài diǎn huí jiā
sentences.english: Now Sanhua just wanted to go home quickly, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以区长说什么她都点头，全部都答应下来了。
sentences.traditional: 所以區長說什麼她都點頭，全部都答應下來了。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ qū zhǎng shuō shén me tā dōu diǎn tóu quán bù dōu dā ying xià lai le
sentences.english: .. so anything the district chief said, she nodded along and agreed to all of it.

raw.synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.
sentence_translations: Will Sanhua Agree?
After Duoxi was arrested, not only was Sanhua not worried, she was actually very happy.
She felt that she was unable to control Duoxi, and wasn’t able to make Duoxi marry Mr. Zhang, ..
.. so the people in the district could control her.
So, when she heard that Duoxi had been arrested, she was not worried and went to bed very early.
The next morning, she woke up very late.
Duoxi’s father, Shuisheng, was very worried, but didn’t dare wake her up, ..
.. so he had no choice but to cook by himself.
He waited for a very long time, and only then did Sanhua get out of bed.
Shuisheng asked her, “Aren’t you going to go ask about Duoxi? I wonder how she’s doing.”
Sanhua laughed, “Why would I go ask about her? Isn’t she not willing to marry Mr. Zhang?
Let her go. You must not go and look for her!”
Shuisheng didn’t dare to say anything.
He finished making the meal, put it on the table and waited for Sanhua.
Only when she was finished getting ready could they start eating.
They hadn’t even finished eating when Big Hei came.
He told Sanhua that the people in the district wanted her to go to the district to ask her some questions.
Sanhua was very happy upon hearing this and said loudly, ..
.. “Our daughter is grown up. We can’t control her anymore.
It just so happens that we can get the district chief to help us control her.”
Sanhua finished eating, changed into beautiful new clothes and new shoes, taking a long time to get ready.
Only then did she let Shuisheng prepare the carriage and take her to the district.
After she arrived in the district, when Sanhua saw the district chief, she grabbed him, saying, ..
.. “District Chief, please help us out, District Chief!!”
The district chief was reading the newspaper.
He put the newspaper aside and saw an old woman gaudily dressed in flowery clothes and bright green shoes.
He couldn’t believe his own eyes and asked, “You … You’re Duoxi’s mother?”
Sanhua nodded her head and said yes.
The district chief pulled her aside and said, “Stand over there!”
Sanhua walked over to the other side of the table.
The district chief looked at Sanhua from head to toe many times and asked, “How old are you?”
“Forty-five,” Sanhua replied.
“Look at yourself. Are you presentable dressed like that?”
Sanhua glanced at her clothes, and didn’t say anything.
The district chief then asked, “I’ve heard that a god lives inside of your body?”
Sanhua didn’t dare reply.
“I’ve heard that you have found a husband for your daughter?”
“That’s right,” Sanhua said quietly.
“How much money did you receive?”
“Ten thousand,” Sanhua’s voice was getting quieter.
“Have you discussed this with your daughter?”
“No.”
“Is your daughter willing?”
“I don’t know!” Sanhua’s voice was barely audible.
“You don’t know? I’ll bring your daughter here for you, and you can ask her yourself.”
After the district chief finished speaking, he got someone to bring Duoxi over.
At this time, many people arrived outside the district chief’s office.
They had all heard from somewhere that there was a gaudily-dressed old woman there, and they wanted to come and look.
They were all standing outside of the office door, talking and laughing.
One person said, “Look! She’s already forty-five and still wearing flowery clothing.”
Another said, “Look, look! Those shoes! Is that a forty-five-year-old wearing them?” …
Sanhua hadn’t ever gotten red in the face in her life. Now she was red in the face and felt very embarrassed.
Duoxi was brought into the district chief’s office.
The district chief looked towards Sanhua, “Ask your daughter if she is willing.”
Sanhua didn’t hear what the district chief said.
She only heard people outside saying “forty-five”, “wearing flowery clothes”, and felt very embarrassed.
The people outside were also saying, “Look, that’s her daughter”, “The daughter doesn’t dress as well as her mother”.
Other people were saying, “I’ve heard that a god lives in her body”.
Someone who knew a little said, “That’s not true. She only says that so she can hang out with young guys” …
After hearing all of this, Sanhua really wanted to run out of the office immediately and go home right away.
The district chief saw that Sanhua wasn’t speaking, and said, ”If you aren’t going to ask, I’ll ask for you!
Duoxi, your mother has found a husband for you. Are you willing to marry him?”
Duoxi said, “No! I haven’t even seen his face; I don’t even know who he is!”
The district chief looked towards Sanhua, “Did you hear that? Duoxi is not willing.
I already asked. Duoxi wants to marry Gao Erhei from your village.
Things are different now than they were in the past.
Now it’s no longer up to the parents to decide to whom their children get married.
Children can decide whom they date and whom they marry. Duoxi and Erhei can get married.
Hurry and return all the greeting gifts from that man, and let Duoxi and Erhei get married …”
Now Sanhua just wanted to go home quickly, ..
.. so anything the district chief said, she nodded along and agreed to all of it.
